title: The manager's state is one capped command and survives compaction
goal: autopilot.py status prints runners (sprint, worktree, pid, alive or exit cause), each active sprint's counts and next item, the operator's pending gates, unratified decisions and the last tick's actions from _cache/autopilot/state.json and ticks.jsonl, with --hook under 1000 characters; a SessionStart hook with the compact matcher prints status --hook, and a PreCompact hook blocks compaction (exit 2) while the land or sync lock is held

gates.question: PreCompact blocks while the land or sync lock is held: any holder on the host, or only a holder of this session's own clone?
options: only a live holder of this clone (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR); any other holder, a gone pid or an error lets compaction run
any live holder on the host
gates.recommendation: only a live holder of this clone (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR); any other holder, a gone pid or an error lets compaction run
gates.answer: only a live holder of this clone (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR); any other holder, a gone pid or an error lets compaction run
